findings.evidence: Concurrent cleanup can pass the single EnsureIssuedStateAsync check and release its provisioning lease before ExecuteSelectedAsync writes/recreates the workspace and starts a child. The selected gate has no cleanup-marker/provisioning lease. Static interleaving confirmed; no new Platform qualification.

RunCoreAsync records a first timestamp, kills/waits, then throws on the current caller cancellation token. NativeTestExecutor samples owner cancellation afterwards, so a later cancellation can replace the earlier timeout cause.

Windows invalid OpenProcess and macOS errors1/13 return null without setting Verified=false. No independent ownership exclusion protects an owned process that becomes inaccessible. Actual-host behavior remains unqualified.
Linux scanner returns(FindProcesses(runId),true), while absent /proc and read exceptions yield no observed processes. The caller can treat this incomplete scan as verified absence and release claims.

ValidResources checks nonnull collections only; ResourceIds and listing serialize containerIds directly. Reviewer reported fake-secret echo on same-source Debug CLI; original stream capture was not retained, so source inspection and reviewer testimony are distinguished.

CreateListCommand awaits ReadAsync without the OperationCanceledException mapping present in validation; enumeration checks cancellation per file. Reported SIGINT repro returned exit1 with empty streams.
Acquire has no receipt-length admission bound; ReadReceipt rejects over64KiB. Retained reviewer fixture is67,001 bytes and ReleaseOwned leaves the receipt. Public Acquire has no identity-count guard.

Reviewer retracted the concrete lifecycle expansion claim after the1MiB validated-descriptor guard was identified. An unrestricted generic writer alone does not demonstrate the claimed reachable oversized lifecycle record. No new guard is justified.

Atomic rename and absence of an explicit stable-storage barrier are confirmed; whether the current promise includes machine/power-loss durability and a reachable lost-terminal-record case were not established. If true impact is medium; settle with an explicit crash contract and fault-injected storage test.
Native Windows/macOS discovery is exercised only through injected/synthetic tests in the Ubuntu lanes. Actual-host ownership/cleanup verification is missing; same root coverage gap as G1.

The cited file is explicitly the failed historical collector attempt, with original temporary inputs preserved. No supported current replay calls it. Parameterizing/duplicating that capture adds a new helper interface for an uncommon archival replay; actual artifact probe03 already accepts explicit repository/version/output/inventory arguments. Clarify its historical status in the handoff without rewriting it.

Batch loop resets ExecutionTiming but not EnvironmentBindings; a descriptor refusal returns before assigning new bindings. TestResultWriter checks owner/attempt/environment only. Retained same-source unit repro contains second selection with first execution/catalog bindings.

Pre-verified gap: source/reference searches and actual CI platforms show no native Windows/macOS reader exercise; override/ContainsEntry tests do not cover discovery or cleanup. Same coverage root cause as B10.
